::: {#exr-reversed-n-gram-model}
#### An $N$-gram model read backward

Let $X_1, X_2, \ldots$ be an [$N$-gram model](#def-n-gram-model) with $N \ge 2$,
let $n \ge N$,
and let $1 \le t \le n - N + 1$.
Show that given all the later variables,
$X_t$ depends only on the $N - 1$ variables just after it:
for every choice of values $x_t, \ldots, x_n$ with $\P(X_{t+1} = x_{t+1}, \ldots, X_n = x_n) > 0$,

$$
\P(X_t = x_t \mid X_{t+1} = x_{t+1}, \ldots, X_n = x_n)
= \P(X_t = x_t \mid X_{t+1} = x_{t+1}, \ldots, X_{t+N-1} = x_{t+N-1}).
$$

:::
